expectation.note: Four-year gaps. A 'yearly' event that fires every four years is correct RFC 5545 and almost never what the author meant.

normative_evidence.quote: Recurrence instances falling on invalid dates ... are ignored

normative_evidence.note: RFC 7529 adds SKIP=OMIT|BACKWARD|FORWARD precisely because RFC 5545 offers only OMIT; eleven years on, the flagship JS RRULE library's documentation does not mention RSCALE at all

rationale: The canonical leap-day vector, and the entry point to RFC 7529: SKIP=BACKWARD would give 28 Feb and SKIP=FORWARD 1 Mar, but neither is available without RSCALE.
title: Yearly on 29 February
